lines.en: Did you see the match last night, Pedro? It was watched by thousands.
lines.pt: Você viu a partida ontem à noite, Pedro? Foi assistida por milhares de pessoas.

lines.en: Yes! The first goal was scored by a young player from our city.
lines.pt: Sim! O primeiro gol foi marcado por um jovem jogador da nossa cidade.

lines.en: And the second goal was scored by our captain, who was hurt in March.
lines.pt: E o segundo gol foi marcado pelo nosso capitão, que se machucou em março.

lines.en: The stadium was built many years ago, and it was filled with fans last night.
lines.pt: O estádio foi construído há muitos anos e ficou cheio de torcedores ontem à noite.

lines.en: The match was on TV, too. It was seen by people around the world.
lines.pt: A partida passou na TV também. Foi vista por pessoas do mundo todo.

lines.en: The tickets were sold in one hour. I was told they were all gone.
lines.pt: Os ingressos foram vendidos em uma hora. Disseram-me que acabaram todos.

lines.en: I was invited by my uncle, and we were given seats near the field.
lines.pt: Fui convidada pelo meu tio e ganhamos lugares perto do campo.

lines.en: Lucky you! The players were welcomed by a big crowd with flags and songs.
lines.pt: Que sorte! Os jogadores foram recebidos por uma grande multidão com bandeiras e músicas.

lines.en: The song was loved by everyone. Even the referee smiled at us.
lines.pt: A música foi adorada por todos. Até o árbitro sorriu para nós.

lines.en: When was the winner chosen? I left before the end.
lines.pt: Quando o vencedor foi escolhido? Eu saí antes do fim.

lines.en: The best player was chosen by the fans after the match. It was our captain!
lines.pt: O melhor jogador foi escolhido pelos torcedores depois da partida. Foi o nosso capitão!

facts.big: The match was watched by thousands
facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + particípio: was watched, were sold, was scored. Use by + quem fez. Pergunte com Was/Were… ou When was…?

facts.label: Foi / foram + particípio
facts.sub: O passivo no passado usa was ou were + particípio: The match was watched. The tickets were sold. Use was no singular e were no plural. O particípio de verbos regulares termina em -ed.

facts.label: Por + quem fez
facts.sub: Use by para dizer quem fez a ação: The goal was scored by our captain. Se o agente não importa ou é óbvio, deixe de fora: The tickets were sold in one hour.
